summary: <cite index="8-3">The Federal Reserve held interest rates unchanged at its October meeting, maintaining the federal funds target range at 3.75%-4.00%</cite>, with <cite index="4-6">futures markets currently assigning a 76% chance of a quarter-point hike at the December FOMC meeting</cite>. Markets closed mixed Monday as <cite index="13-4">Apple shares were down after the tech giant issued a disappointing margin forecast and reported weaker-than-expected fourth-quarter iPad sales</cite>, while <cite index="15-8,15-9">chip stocks pushed the Nasdaq higher in late morning trading on Tuesday, though Apple's drop wiped about $107 billion off its market value</cite>. The crypto sector faced continued pressure as <cite index="23-4,23-5">BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) lost $405.3 million on Monday, its biggest daily withdrawal since June, with the group's net withdrawals at $398.6 million</cite>, extending a difficult month amid <cite index="23-9,23-10">volatility triggered by the $6.3 billion Binance hack, with Bitcoin momentarily dipping under $76,400 on Monday, marking its weakest point since August</cite>. U.S. midterm elections added another layer of uncertainty to trading sentiment.

signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs suffer $399M outflows as BlackRock leads exodus
signals.desc: Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $398.6 million in outflows Monday led by BlackRock's IBIT fund shedding $405 million, signaling institutional risk-off amid the Binance hack fallout and election uncertainty.

signals.title: Apple margin warning wipes $107 billion in market value
signals.desc: Apple issued a disappointing profit margin forecast and weak iPad sales, triggering a selloff that erased over $100 billion in market cap and pressured the Dow lower on Election Day.

signals.title: Fed holds rates at 3.75%-4.00%, December hike 76% priced in
signals.desc: The Federal Reserve paused rate hikes at its October meeting following September's 25bp increase, with markets pricing in a three-quarter probability of another hike in December.

signals.title: Semiconductor stocks rebound despite Apple weakness
signals.desc: Chip stocks lifted the Nasdaq higher in midday trading Tuesday with Nvidia rebounding sharply, offsetting Apple's drag as investors await AMD earnings after the close.

signals.title: Binance hack aftermath keeps Bitcoin near $76,400 support
signals.desc: The $6.3 billion Binance security breach continues to weigh on crypto sentiment with Bitcoin testing critical support at $76,400 and the Fear & Greed Index at extreme fear levels.

verdict: Risk appetite remains bifurcated with semiconductors offsetting mega-cap tech weakness while crypto digests institutional outflows and election uncertainty ahead of key AMD earnings and midterm results.
